title: Power falls as a line-ending null fixes more of the observed endpoints
statement: For a K-024-open-1 calibration, sample 160 Currier B paragraph line lengths from the pinned public ZL training split. Keep initial slots fixed and simulate only the binary last-glyph feature of each noninitial token. The interior probability is 1%, and the final probability ranges from 1% to 18%. Use 1,500 independent replicate books per rate. On the same book compare four conditional permutation nulls that fix 0%, 50%, 90%, or 100% of observed line endings. The masks are nested, fixed by a separate seed before simulating outcomes, and all tests use inclusive exact upper tails at alpha=0.01.
check: Replicate the embedded pilot with the stored simulation plan, then repeat under different public layout samples and independently seeded masks. If extending to the production F-001 rule, test its finite 10× ratio cutoff and its exact token-permutation implementation separately from the permutation-only power measured here.
findings: For a 5% final rate versus a 1% interior rate, detection was 70.7%, 38.3%, 3.1% and 0% as the locked share rose. For a 10% final rate the corresponding rates were 99.5%, 89.6%, 15.7% and 0%. With no effect the four rejection counts were 5, 5, 0 and 0 out of 1,500, consistent with conservative discrete tests. The JSON includes the full grid and Wilson intervals.
interpretation: Given k marked tokens among n noninitial slots, the unfrozen final token is marked with probability k/n under a uniform within-line permutation. Independent lines give a Poisson-binomial tail. Fixed endpoints contribute the same constant to the observation and every draw, so they cancel from the tail. At complete fixation all draws tie and the inclusive p-value is 1 by construction. The production DSL rejects such an immobile null. The pilot keeps initials fixed in every condition and measures permutation power for a count at one layout and set of masks. F-001 additionally uses a ratio cutoff and permutes whole words, including initial slots. The pilot contains no measured feature rates from the manuscript and leaves the actual source of its line-final effects open.
reproduction: Write `python` to null_power.py and results.plan to plan.json. Run from the checkout with PYTHONHASHSEED=0 PYTHONPATH=. python3 null_power.py plan.json result.json after fetching the pinned inputs. Two runs produced byte-identical JSON. The tail was also compared to exhaustive enumeration on 30 independently drawn small examples.
